name: agentx
description: AgentX plugins for Claude Code — production tracing for your own agent, and evaluation triage against a self-hosted AgentX engine

plugins.name: agentx-eval-fix
plugins.description: Turn an AgentX self-host evaluation into a triaged code fix and a re-run against the same dataset, so the before and after scores mean something next to each other.

plugins.name: agentx-tracing
plugins.description: Wire AgentX production tracing into an existing Python agent: fetch the project key from the engine, write .env.agentx, initialise the SDK, and instrument the calls worth tracing.
